svg.text: One per payload. Blank 184 x 128 mm from 5 mm plate; ends and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: long edges square and straight (they run in the rail).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cable notch in the front edge: 18 mm deep, 28 mm wide, centred.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pin holes 5.5 mm: 12 mm from the rear edge, 9 mm in from each

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: long edge (55 mm each side of the centre line).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Payload holes: four 4.5 mm, countersunk on the TOP face for M4,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: at 26 and 146 mm from the rear edge, 30 mm each side of centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Chamfer the rear corners 2 mm so the shoe finds the rail.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: slides the full rail length without binding; both pins

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: drop into their holes at the front stops.
